about: SGT never-miss work packages (blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md, with section 10 owner answers and section 10a review corrections). Fixed data: edit by hand only to re-plan. Live status is in sgt-never-miss-status.csv, written only by tools/sgt_never_miss.py. Workers run on main in the APP folder (owner decision 2026-10-14).

tiers._note: Claude only. Opus for WP3, WP4, WP5, WP10 and the final review (owner answer D15).

wps.what: Baseline: the test suite before any change
wps.focus: Change no code. Run the whole suite once with `venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_never_miss_suite.py` (Bash timeout 600000 ms; if it times out, run it again on tests/test_sgt_*.py tests/test_vsdc_*.py and say so). In your hand-off note list the T/F/S counts and the node ids of every failing test: these are the pre-existing failures every later WP compares against. Also run `venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_replay.py --help` and record how a baseline is taken. Add section `## 14. Hand-off notes` with the line `(written by each WP)` at the end of the blueprint if it is missing.

wps.what: Probe pack: the Windows measurements tool
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 9 WP0, plus R9 (add a `read-timing` run with two windows of one browser read at once vs one at a time) and R10. Build the tool and its tests only. NEVER run a probe against a real browser window (rule 1): the owner runs them. Done = tests pass and `--help` works. Record the owner STOP as checks: one check per probe (doc-url, read-timing, read-timing --mta, gate, toast, switches), each saying the exact command and what to fill in the blueprint's section 12.

wps.what: Capture health: states, HUD event, phone alert, log
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 7.1 and section 9 WP1 as written. Owner answers D8 (20 s, 5 min / 30 min) apply. The HUD stays momentary (constraint 8). Record the STOP (HUD wording) as a check.

wps.what: Rows never lost: database retry and dead letter
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 9 WP2, with R11: do NOT add `PRAGMA busy_timeout` (the connection already waits 5 s); the retry and the dead letter are the work. Done when a test holds a write lock longer than 5 s while a row is queued and the row still lands.

wps.what: Reader v2: MTA lanes, cached read, tickets, torn detection, Document URL
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md sections 4.2, 4.3, 4.5, 4.6 and section 9 WP3, with R2 (each lane has a content worker AND a scope worker; URL-only jobs never wait behind a page read), R3 (a URL-only request never replaces a queued page read), R9 (at most one heavy read per browser process) and R4 (no SDIS change). Owner answers D1 = yes and D2 = MTA. Add every test named in WP3 and in R2, R3, R9. The owner STOP (equivalence tool on the real corpus, three live pages) becomes checks.

wps.what: CaptureLoop: the SGT path out of the router
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md sections 4.4, 4.7 (foreground-only first), 4.8 and section 9 WP4, with R2 (the scope gate uses the scope worker, so heavy reads keep it fresh), R7 (keep the router's own URL read for the crosshair engines; delete nothing of it) and R10 (FRAME_TICK_SEC default 0.35 until WP0's gate probe is measured; keep 0.2 as the named alternative). Owner answers D4, D5, D7 apply.

wps.what: SGT absorbs by provenance: late results, torn and blind rules, source policy
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md sections 5.2, 6.1 to 6.3 and section 9 WP5, with R1 (a URL-torn read is dropped and re-read; the closed ring never absorbs across a logout, a login page or an identity contradiction) and R6 (OCR raises a status only together with an identifier). Replace and add the tests R1 and R6 name. Owner answer D3 accepted. The owner STOP (replay diff on the real corpus) becomes a check.

wps.what: Simulation harness and the six day profiles
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 8 and section 9 WP6. Profiles 1 to 6 must pass with zero missed and zero mis-attributed submissions. Add a harness case for R1 (logout then the next client in the same tab during a read) and for R2 (a toast during a 5 s read). The `--real` runs are recorded as a check if they would exceed this session.

wps.what: Change gate v2 tuning and the flash OCR trigger
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md sections 4.4, 5.1, 5.3 and section 9 WP7, with R2 (the flash trigger fires during a heavy read because scope stays fresh) and R6. Owner answer D4 applies.
Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 9 WP8 as written (constraint 7: OCR on GST, add-only).

Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 6.4 and section 9 WP9, with the owner answer D13: IDLE_END_SEC = 4 h, RESUME_WINDOW_SEC = 12 h, the router's _SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC = 4 h, and the test `test_router_prune_never_precedes_sgt_idle_end`. The STOP (12 h on disk) becomes a check.

wps.what: Visible windows that are not in front
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 4.7 and section 9 WP10, owner answer D6 = yes, D11 rejected (BROWSER_EXE_NAMES unchanged, no `browsers` key in vsdc_scope.json). R9 applies to background windows too. The STOP (a day with it on: CPU, heartbeat lanes) becomes a check.

wps.what: Recovery: the latest filing on list and status pages
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 6.5 and section 9 WP11, with R5: `latest_period_only` is NOT changed; a list page gives only its latest filing, which may create a slot marked recovered or upgrade an existing row. Golden sessions expect one row. The owner step (label lines from the corpus) cannot be waited for: ship the two record specs disabled (`"disabled": true`) with a note, and record the owner step as a check saying exactly which labels to paste into docs/sgt-recovery-spec-notes.md.

wps.what: Fleet health view and the mandatory update path
wps.focus: Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md sections 7.2 to 7.4 and section 9 WP12, with R8: the sharing interval is the app setting `capture_health_sync_min` (Settings -> Tracker, spin box 1-60 minutes, default 15) plus a record at once on every state change; replace the once-a-minute test as R8 says. Owner answers D10 and D12 apply. Never set `mandatory` in version.json yourself: record it as a check for the owner's next release.

Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 8.2 and section 9 WP13. Build the tool and its fixture tests; the 5 h soaks are owner checks (an office PC with real work, the dev PC with mock pages).

Blueprint docs/sgt-never-miss-blueprint.md section 9 WP14, section 11 (with R4 and R12 already applied) and section 10a. For each scenario id confirm the named test exists and passes, or mark it. Update the docs WP14 names.

Review everything built against docs/sgt-stress-problem-report.md section 2 (constraints 1-12), the blueprint's sections 10 and 10a (owner answers, R1-R13) and section 8.2 (acceptance). Read every commit of this project (`git log --oneline` from the restore-point tag `restore-point/pre-sgt-never-miss`). Run the whole suite with `venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_never_miss_suite.py` (Bash timeout 600000 ms) and compare with WB's note; run tests/test_sgt_replay.py. Grep the diff since the tag for page text, PAN/GSTIN/ARN shapes and client names. Fix defects. Write a merge-readiness note at the end of the hand-off section: what is done, what failed, every owner check still open, and the release steps (D12 mandatory flag).
